findings.cdpam: Human-judgment-trained full-reference perceptual metric; speech enhancement use is already reported in the original work.
findings.nomad: Unsupervised non-matching-reference embedding trained with NSIM-guided triplets; usable as a pretrained perceptual distance, not a new mechanism here.
findings.generative_objectives: The 2025 study evaluates diffusion objectives and adds differentiable PESQ plus time-domain L1 to an SB data-prediction objective; this is not the current OUVE score-matching branch. Its reported M5/M6/M7/M8 PESQ-SI-SDR tradeoffs reinforce that a perceptual term is a baseline to test, not an assumed win.
findings.compatibility: sgmse/model.py enables its differentiable PESQ term only for loss_type=data_prediction; JointFrontendSgmseModel and RRSD/no-regret paths enforce score_matching with sigma^2.
findings.novelty_implication: A bare perceptual loss, CDPAM/NOMAD insertion, or PESQ term would be a baseline/ablation and cannot by itself be claimed as the StoRM innovation.

next_gate: wait for exploratory listening evidence; if a reproducible StoRM-specific distortion is identified, design a matched backend-only probe rather than changing Router alpha
